page.layout: Two columns of a Hebrew-Latin word list on one printed page. Left column, from top to bottom: entries from "Niph. 3. pl. R." to "evanuerunt". Right column, from top to bottom: entries from "eripiemur" to "liquefit". Page number at top left. Running head at top, Hebrew letters. Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.l: moti fuerunt, praet. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. מָטַט, vel טוּט.
נִמִּיתָה interficiemus, נִמִּיתֶךָ te, וּנִמִּיתֵהוּ eum, נִמִּיתֶם eos, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. aff. Rad. מוּת.
venditus fuit, נִמְכַּר venditi fuerunt, praet. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. מָכַר.
vendemus eum, נִמְכְּרֶנּוּ fut. Kal, 1. pl. נִמְכּוֹר aff. Rad. מָכַר.
נִמְלָא implebimus, fut. Pi-el, 1. pl. R. מָלָא.
נִמְלָא oppletus est, praet. Niph. 3. f. m. R. מָלָא.
נִמְלָה formica, No. sing. fem. Rad. נָמַל circumcidit.
נִמְלוּ circumcisi sunt, praet. Niph. 3. pl. R. נָמַל.
נִמְלְחוּ evanuerunt, praet. Niph. 3. pl. R. מָלַח.
[?]ripiemur, fut. Niph. 1. pl. à praet. Niph. נִמְלְטוּ; Rad. מָלַט.
נִמְלַךְ, vel נִמְלָךְ regnare faciemus, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. Rad. מָלַךְ.
נִמָּלִים circumcisi, Part. Niph. pl. m. R. נָמַל, ex forma Cholem ut supra נִמְלוֹ.
נִמָּלִים formicae, pl. m. No. f. f. נִמָּלָה; Rad. נָמַל circumcidit.
נִמְלָן suave fuit, נִמְלוּ suavia fuerunt, praet. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. מָלַן.
נִמְלְתֶּם circumcidistis, praet. Kal, 2. pl. masc. Rad. נָמַל.
נִמְנָה annumeratus fuit, נִמְנַע cohibitus fuit, praet. Niph. 3. f. m. Rad. מָנָה, & מָנַע.
נִמַּס liquefit, pro נִמְּסוּ liquefiunt, praet. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. R. מָסַס.

page.notes: Hebrew letters inside the entries are only partly legible at this scan resolution, especially the vowel points and the inner letters of the forms. They are transcribed as best as possible and should be checked against the original. The first word of the right column, "eripiemur", is partly hidden by a Hebrew form and is marked [?]. The first Hebrew line on the left is uncertain. The running head shows Hebrew letters נ מ, not a Latin title. No printed page number is visible on the right-hand column.
